config.elixir.title: Elixir Config
config.elixir.option.pharma_limited.tool: Pharma beyond this range has no effect
config.elixir.option.pharma_conversion_r: Final effect magnitude is divided by this
config.elixir.option.highest_pharma_limi: Pills above this pharma grade as §cExtreme+§r
When pharma exceeds the cap and the raw target temperature leaves the bar range (extreme case), clamp it this far from the edge; normal refining is left untouched
config.elixir.option.temp_safe_margin.to: Temperature cap = explosion line + this value; the explosion line always sits this far below the cap, and the fan can heat up to the cap; config-only, unaffected by experience
config.elixir.option.bad_elixir_compensa: Random pharma range for waste pills, multiplied by the pharma cap
config.elixir.option.stability_loss_rate: Exponentially affects the stability base of repeated materials
config.elixir.option.refine_ticks.toolti: Total refining time = pharma x this value, clamped between 200 and 1200 ticks
config.elixir.option.hud_scale.tooltip: Overall scale of the alchemy feedback HUD (temperature bar, stability bar, etc.); 1 is the smallest, up to 4x
config.elixir.option.exp_success_gain.to: Experience gained for each successful refinement
config.elixir.option.exp_failure_gain.to: Experience gained for each failed refinement
config.elixir.option.exp_growth_rate.too: Steepness of the experience benefit curve; higher means slower growth, lower means faster
config.elixir.option.temp_range_base.too: Temperature tolerance at zero experience; experience increases it (scaled by growth rate)
config.elixir.option.temp_range_max.tool: Cap of the temperature tolerance experience can grant; approaches this value as experience grows
Ticks before overheating explodes at zero experience
Extra ticks experience can add to the explosion delay; approaches this cap as experience grows
config.elixir.option.failed_delay_base.t: Ticks before low temperature fails at zero experience
config.elixir.option.failed_delay_gain.t: Extra ticks experience can add to the cold failure delay; approaches this cap as experience grows
